A '''heatbeam''' was a weapon that fired [[Color/Legends|yellow]]<ref name="HSLL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref> jets of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]]. [[Laser/Legends|Lasers]] were used to create the plasma, and the weapon produced a superheated exhaust when fired. [[Soldier/Legends|Soldiers]] in [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] armed forces who carried heatbeams were known as "[[heatbeamer]]s", and wore fire-proof padded [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and [[Kama/Legends|kamas]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Xim's [[war-robot]]s were armed with heatbeams built into the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] right gauntlet.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
